ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base comprising approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/off-white) clusters concentrated on distal tips and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous mottling localized at the distal extremities of both lobes. Right lobe distal region shows a dense cluster of white pixels; left lobe distal region exhibits a mixture of white speckling and solid white clustering along the outer lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees; depth of notch is roughly one-quarter of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge, characterized by sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, particularly prominent on the outer thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of circular, high-contrast white structures (barnacles) on the extreme lateral edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel tracks visible on the inner medial surface of the left lobe, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable protrusion of calcified organisms on the far-left lateral margin; irregular jagged 'bite' or deep serration on the mid-right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white border localized specifically to the jagged peaks of the right lobe's trailing edge.
